headline: About 960 customers could not pay by card on the iPhone app
cause: The card pay screen opens blank on iOS app 8.3

answer.title: The pay screen is blank for cards on iPhone
answer.text: Since app 8.3 reached iPhones at 9:20 am, choosing a card opens an empty screen. No payment is made, so Razorpay has nothing to match. The count is an estimate, worked out from carts that reached the pay screen and stopped.

compared: Compared with your card checkouts in the same hours the day before
cannot_see: customers who left the app before they reached the pay screen

root.cause: After the iOS app 8.3 update, the pay screen opens blank when the customer picks a card. Razorpay never sees an attempt, so these are counted from carts, not payments.
root.fix: Roll the Razorpay SDK in app 8.3 back to the version in 8.2, or ship a patch, and invite the customers back.
signals: card checkouts opened blank from 9:20 am
every one is the iOS app, version 8.3
Android and web card payments were normal

actions.title: Send your app team the cause
actions.text: The SDK version that broke the pay screen, the 8.2 version that worked, and when card checkouts started opening blank.

actions.title: Send your team about 640 lost carts
actions.text: About ₹7,80,860 of carts were left. The list has cart IDs, values and times, so the carts can be kept open.

actions.title: Message about 640 customers
actions.text: Tells them card payments on the iPhone app had a fault and their cart is saved. In your name. It waits until your team has the carts.

closing: The cause was your app, not Razorpay or a bank. The count is an estimate from carts. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was sent.

rca.title: Root cause: the card pay screen is blank on iOS app 8.3
lines: Whose side: your app code. Confidence: likely, 3 signals agree. The count is an estimate from carts.
Started: 9:20 am, with the iOS 8.3 rollout. Android and web card payments are normal.
Affected: about 960 customers left the card pay screen without paying.
Fix: roll back the SDK in 8.3, or patch it.
rca.signed_off: Signed off by Razorpay support at 9:43 am
